d.seg: ನಂದು ಏಜ್ ಟೂ ಮಂತ್ಸ್ ಆಯಿತು ಫುಲ್ ಬಾಡಿ ಓಪನ್ ಶೋ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ
d.tr: My age is two months (on the app), I will do a full body open show, will you watch?
d.ctx: The speaker talks about doing a full body open show and asks if the other person will watch.
d.j: It matches the strong case for Explicit-Flirting by offering to show the body.

d.seg: ಮುಣ್ಣೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ೌಟ್ ಆಗೋವರೆಗೂ ತೋರ್ಸ್ತೀನಿ ಮುಣ್ಣೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಓಕೆ ಅಂದರೆ ವಾಟ್ಸಪ್ ನಂಬರ್ ಕೌದ್ತೀನಿ ವೀಡಿಯೋ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ
d.tr: 300 rupees, I will show until you finish. If 300 rupees is okay, I will give my WhatsApp number, make a video call.
d.ctx: The expert asks for payment for showing her body and offers a WhatsApp number to continue outside.
d.j: It matches the strong case for SuspiciousActivity by linking money to showing the body.

d.seg: ವಾಟ್ಸಪ್ ನಂಬರ್ ಕೌದ್ತೀನಿ ವೀಡಿಯೋ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ
d.tr: I will give my WhatsApp number, make a video call.
d.ctx: The expert offers to give her WhatsApp number and move the call there after payment discussion.
d.j: It matches the strong case for PlatformMove by proposing to move to WhatsApp and sharing contact info.

d.seg: ನಾಇನ್ ಒನ್ ನಾಇನ್ ಒನ್ ಏಟ್ ಸೆವನ್ ಏಟ್ ಸೆವನ್ ಫೋರ್ ಸಿಕ್ಸ್ ತ್ರೀ ಫೋರ್ ಡಬಲ್ ಜೀರೋ
d.ctx: The expert recites her phone number to continue the conversation outside the app.
d.j: It matches the strong case for PlatformMove by giving a phone number.
